summary: Frontend-only verification of Home header/hero gap fix. All layout assertions passed on desktop (1348x926) and mobile (390x844). Scope protection on /about-us, /careers, /contact confirmed unchanged.

mobile_home_390x844.note: Mobile uses the 7rem (112px) fallback of .bb-main-home (media query only activates >=1024px), which is expected/correct behavior.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix verified. Desktop Home header ends at 103.25, hero starts at 103 (sub-pixel overlap, no 8-9px band). Header border on Home is 1px solid rgb(212,216,232) with no box-shadow. Nav collapses 68->64 on scroll and border persists. Other pages (/about-us, /careers, /contact) retain 76px nav, 112px main paddingTop, transparent header border-bottom when not scrolled. Mobile Home renders fine, no horizontal scroll, mobile menu toggle works.
rca of the issue: Original bug caused by main padding-top (112px) larger than reduced fixed header height (~103px on Home desktop) producing a pale 8-9px band. Fix uses route-scoped .bb-main-home class with 103px padding at >=1024px on Home only, plus 1px solid #d4d8e8 header border on Home to eliminate visual seam. Verified GAP = -0.25px (sub-pixel overlap = no visible band).
